messages.subject: failed new plot?
parts:
Hi all,

I have been running plots with this script and it does exactly want I needed.

library(ggplot2)

setwd("E:/Bat papers in prep/Boden Creek Carbon bats")
bats <- read.table("2007.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
#this is tab delimited format

summary(bats)

bats.melt <- melt(bats, id.vars=c("Species", "Month"))
bats.melt$Month <- factor(bats.melt$Month, levels=c("June", "July", "August"))

theme_set(theme_bw())
qplot(variable, geom="bar", facets=Month~Species, fill=variable, weight=value, data=bats.melt)
#the following is defining the X, Y labels
last_plot() +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank(), axis.title.y = theme_blank(),legend.position = "none")

And now now I have set this up the same way with just a new data set
but something is not working.               
  

bats.melt <- melt(bats, id.vars=c("Species", "Month"))
bats.melt$Month <- factor(bats.melt$Month, levels=c("June07","November07"))
theme_set(theme_bw())

qplot(variable, geom="bar", facets=Month~Species, fill=variable, weight=value, data=bats.melt)
last_plot() +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank(), axis.title.y = theme_blank(),legend.position = "none")
                                               
>
> bats.melt <- melt(bats, id.vars=c("Species", "Month"))
> bats.melt$Month <- factor(bats.melt$Month, levels=c("June07", "November07"))
> theme_set(theme_bw())
> qplot(variable, geom="bar", facets=Month~Species, fill=variable, weight=value, data=bats.melt)
Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, var, value = list(`NA` = NULL)) :
  missing values are not allowed in subscripted assignments of data frames
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
2: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
3: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
4: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
5: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
> #the following is definimg the X, Y lables
> last_plot() +
+ opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank(), axis.title.y = theme_blank(),legend.position = "none")
Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, var, value = list(`NA` = NULL)) :
  missing values are not allowed in subscripted assignments of data frames
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
2: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
3: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
4: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
5: In max(abs(density), na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

There must be something obvious wrong, although it is not to me???
